title: The routing rules
description: What routing-rules.yml holds in a directory that `ingestion connectors apply` sends. Each rule places an item on a destination before any model reads it, and the side gate records its decision as by rule:<name>.

match.description: What the rule holds for. Each condition it names must hold, and it names at least one.

connector.description: Holds for an item this connector sighted. The set declares the connector.

tag.description: Holds for an item a sighting tagged with this.

field.description: A field of the source's payload, such as a Reddit save's subreddit.

values.description: The values of field the rule holds for.

destination.description: The destination the rule places an item on, which destinations.yml declares.
